description: Raid: Depot Hit: radio lead-in, calls and sign-offs.

briefing: Three freighters parked at a depot in {system}. {client} wants them gone. The guards are awake.
Supply depot. Hit the freighters, then leave. Do not linger for the guards.
Raid on {enemy} supplies. Three hulls and a thin guard.
success: Depot destroyed. {client} pays {captain} and asks no questions.
The depot is gone. Off you go.
failure: The depot survives. {client} is not pleased.
The raid fails. {enemy} resupply on schedule.
radio-depot: Depot ahead. Three freighters, three guards.
There it is. Freighters at rest, guards on watch.
Targets in view. Go for the haulers.
radio-alarm: They called for help. Four ships, left.
More {enemy} ships inbound. Finish the freighters.
